member.name: M:AppShell.Core.Commands.CommandParser.NamePattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[A-Za-z_][\\w-]*(\\.[A-Za-z_][\\w-]*)*$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z_a-z].
○ Match a character in the set [-\w] greedily any number of times.
○ Loop greedily any number of times.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match '.'.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z_a-z].
○ Match a character in the set [-\w] atomically any number of times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
